   • CVR: 0.66% → 0.69% (+5%, ~flat)
   • AOV: 1,593 → 1,509 EGP (-5%, down (drag))
   *Who moved it:* *CPC 58%* of the move (hurt, -60,686 EGP)  ·  *AOV 23%* of the move (hurt, -113,316 EGP)  ·  *CVR 19%* of the move (helped, +88,621 EGP).
   *Read:* *CPC* rose +14%, the biggest of the three.
     Worth about *-60,686 EGP of spend*.
     That drove ROAS -13%.
     Revenue -6% because spend +8%.
   *Deeper:* biggest single mover was *Dorganize - Tank*, its CPC went 2.71 EGP→1.39 EGP on 7,448 EGP spend (~12% of the swing).
